name: cobol-lexer-literal-and-period-limits
body: The lexer joins continued words, numerics, PICTURE strings and literals, drops comma/semicolon separators before a space or line end, and keeps a '.' inside a word whenever a non-space follows, so `X.)` and `X.==` stay one word. It reads X"..." as a word plus a literal and treats column-7 'D' lines as comments. Limit: hexadecimal literals and debugging lines are not modelled, and a comma or semicolon followed by a continuation still yields a token. Upgrade when a dialect or corpus needs hex literals, debugging mode, `.==` pseudo-text or that separator form.
